page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8a.12xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz and includes 32 KB of L1d cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results show strong performance across multiple compute-heavy workloads. The instance ranks in the top 25% for stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, as well as Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations. It demonstrates strong capabilities in software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. Cryptographic and mathematical operations are supported by hardware-level instruction sets, including AVX-512, AES, and SHA extensions, which is reflected in its top-tier Passmark CPU encryption and extended instructions scores.

While cached memory bandwidth is strong at 3646.1 GB/sec, uncached large-block read and write memory bandwidths fall into the average tier, representing a potential bottleneck for memory-bound applications handling large, uncached datasets. Additionally, static web serving throughput and Redis SET operations perform in the middle 50% tier. Given the high compute density and strong multi-threaded decompression capabilities, this instance is suited for compute-intensive tasks such as software compilation, physics simulations, and image processing, rather than memory-intensive databases or local storage-reliant workloads.
